📢 Calling Advocates Practicing Across Uttar Pradesh

We are looking to connect with experienced Advocates practicing across the State of Uttar Pradesh who have strong expertise in:

⚖️ SARFAESI & Recovery Matters
⚖️ DRT & DRAT Proceedings
⚖️ NCLT & IBC Matters
⚖️ Consumer Disputes
⚖️ Civil Litigation & Commercial Disputes

We are particularly interested in advocates with strong court exposure, sound legal knowledge, and experience in handling matters for Banks, NBFCs and Financial Institutions.

📍 Location: Across Uttar Pradesh
• Agra Division – Agra, Firozabad, Mainpuri, Mathura
• Prayagraj Division – Prayagraj, Fatehpur, Kaushambi, Pratapgarh
• Bareilly Division – Bareilly, Badaun, Pilibhit, Shahjahanpur
• Chitrakoot Division – Banda, Chitrakoot, Hamirpur, Mahoba
• Ayodhya Division – Ayodhya, Ambedkar Nagar, Amethi, Barabanki, Sultanpur
• Gorakhpur Division – Gorakhpur, Deoria, Kushinagar, Maharajganj
• Jhansi Division – Jalaun, Jhansi, Lalitpur
• Kanpur Division – Kanpur Nagar, Auraiya, Etawah, Farrukhabad, Kannauj, Kanpur Dehat
• Lucknow Division – Lucknow, Hardoi, Lakhimpur Kheri, Raebareli, Sitapur, Unnao
• Meerut Division – Meerut, Bagpat, Bulandshahr, Gautam Buddha Nagar, Ghaziabad, Hapur
• Mirzapur Division – Mirzapur, Bhadohi, Sonbhadra
• Saharanpur Division – Saharanpur, Muzaffarnagar, Shamli
• Varanasi Division – Varanasi, Chandauli, Ghazipur, Jaunpur

If you are interested in collaborating with us or becoming part of our legal network, please DM or drop mail at avani@beinlegalllp.com to us with your profile, areas of practice, and the districts/cities where you practice.

🤝 Let’s build a strong professional legal network across Uttar Pradesh.

comment: A strong district-level network in these areas also depends on timely coordination between counsel, local courts, and recovery teams. In banking matters, execution strategy often matters as much as legal knowledge.
